name: swing-music
description: Swing is a music player for local audio files built with both visual coolness and functionality in mind. Just run the app and enjoy your music library in a web browser. **Before you install:** cd /mnt/user/appdata git clone https://github.com/swing-opensource/swingmusic.git --depth 1 cd swingmusic docker build . -t swingmusic **Import Music:** Settings > Choose Modify at Change your root directories > Customize root directories > choose / and then select the music folder
